threats.threat: An untrusted UI, hook, agent, or direct-store path advances workflow state without Controller policy and revision validation.

controls.description: Only the Controller may accept state-changing intents; UI, hooks, transcripts, and PTY parsers submit non-authoritative signals.

evidence.requirement: Independent negative tests for direct-store writes, forged Accepted Events, and unauthorized state transitions.

threats.threat: A Project B actor reads, writes, infers, or collides with Project A state through API, database keys, events, cache, cursor, or session namespaces.

controls.description: Every persistent object and query is project-scoped; schema, authorization, cache keys, cursors, and namespaces reject mixed-project references.

evidence.requirement: Independent fresh Project A/B negative matrix across database, API, events, cache, cursor, session, and quota surfaces.

threats.threat: An Auditor observes unapproved Implementer material or another Auditor verdict before the Reveal Gate, invalidating independent review.

controls.description: Create independent ContextSnapshots and result namespaces; filter subscriptions and queries until a visibility manifest is sealed and Reveal Gate permits fan-in.

evidence.requirement: Independent blind-review visibility proof covering API, event subscription, UI projection, prompt manifest, and result namespace.

threats.threat: A handle is guessed, replayed, inherited, used across scope, or causes reusable authentication material to enter arguments, logs, output, crash dumps, artifacts, or Git.

controls.description: Resolve opaque handles only host-locally for the target Project, Role, and Assignment; fail closed on revoke or provider failure and redact all exportable planes.

evidence.requirement: Independent synthetic-canary tests for guessing, cross-scope use, revoke, child inheritance, provider failure, and every exportable plane.

boundary: Runner -> Process Supervisor -> Harness child process
threats.threat: Stale lease or fence, close/spawn race, PID reuse, host crash, or runner loss causes two writable attempts or an orphan process to be treated as successful.

controls.description: Use one fenced Process Supervisor with non-reusable scope identity, pre-execution containment, linearized spawn/close, durable recovery reports, and UNKNOWN on unproven termination.

evidence.requirement: Independent Windows process matrix for root/child/grandchild containment, nested Job, PID reuse seam, close/spawn race, crash, and output loss.

threats.threat: Untrusted paths, reparse points, case or Unicode confusion, stale attempts, or cross-project manifests escape a registered root or write the wrong worktree or Git namespace.

controls.description: Canonicalize paths under registered roots, reject reparse escapes, allocate per-Project/Agent/Assignment/Attempt workspaces, and require fenced Git materialization.

evidence.requirement: Independent Windows path and Git negative tests for traversal, UNC, junction, symlink, case/Unicode collision, stale attempt, and cross-project write.

threats.threat: PTY output, exit code, transcript, stale version evidence, or a private shim is mistaken for a fresh authoritative terminal receipt.

controls.description: Preserve evidence strength and freshness; only permitted native evidence may form a receipt, while degraded evidence emits a visible event and cannot promote task state.

evidence.requirement: Independent conformance cases for protocol/hook loss, PTY success text, exit zero, stale terminal events, version drift, and receipt-chain validation.

boundary: Control Plane -> Context Compiler -> Adapter Projector
threats.threat: Mandatory context is omitted, conflicting context is silently replaced, or a stale or escaped projection is loaded while execution continues.

controls.description: Compile deterministic overlays with included/omitted/conflict manifests and canonical hashes; require current load proof and fail closed on mandatory, path, collision, or hash violations.

evidence.requirement: Independent projector negatives for four-layer overlay, mandatory omission, conflict, hash drift, stale load proof, Windows copy path, and path escape.

threats.threat: A staged, altered, cross-project, deleted, or unavailable artifact is accepted as Gate evidence, or sensitive content is retained to preserve an apparent pass.

controls.description: Verify project scope, producer, revision, size, digest, classification, and retention before RETAINED evidence; quarantine secrets and surface EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE after loss.

evidence.requirement: Independent artifact lifecycle tests for prepare/finalize unknown, scope deduplication, redaction, quota, HOLD, delete outcome, restore, and unavailable evidence.

threats.threat: An unreviewed dependency, substituted source, missing notice, mismatched SBOM, or unsigned package is promoted toward release.

controls.description: Bind source revision, lockfiles, dependency hashes, license and NOTICE records, build outputs, SBOM, provenance, and signature verification to one candidate build.

evidence.requirement: Independent provenance and license checks for dependency changes, source/hash mismatch, SBOM/NOTICE completeness, package contents, and signature verification.

threats.threat: A failed, interrupted, repeated, or incompatible upgrade/rollback leaves mixed binaries, schema, data, credentials, or references and is misreported as recovered.

controls.description: Use versioned migration, verified backup/restore, explicit compatibility or recovery states, signed package identity, and no direct downgrade of incompatible data.

evidence.requirement: Independent clean-host install, upgrade interruption, rollback, uninstall, restart recovery, and backup/restore matrix from one fixed candidate build.

threats.threat: Crash, partial write, WAL loss, storage exhaustion, or restore ambiguity causes state corruption or blind replay of a non-idempotent side effect.

controls.description: Fail-stop on uncertain persistence, preserve DB/WAL evidence, restore in isolation, validate integrity/FK constraints, and reconcile before new writes.

evidence.requirement: Independent crash, WAL, failed backup, restore, migration, BUSY, and commit-outcome-unknown cases with recovery and side-effect traces.

threats.threat: Natural-language output or Task completion is treated as authorization for merge, deploy, install, credential-scope expansion, deletion, payment, or release.

controls.description: Require explicit Policy ASK/DENY and independent human/Owner decisions for high-risk actions; CI can report evidence but cannot authorize release.

evidence.requirement: Independent negative tests proving Task completion and natural-language authorization cannot cause high-risk side effects without a recorded decision.
